Name: Stardew Valley (of the Elves)
Author: devilfern
Description:
[center]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/HrTYjd4.png?1[/img]
Stardew Valley (of the Elves)
A simple portrait mod that replaces the default portrait images with original artwork by me, Devilfern. [/center]

Stardew Valley is an idyllic little place, sheltered from the harsh modern world. There's some magic in the air here, so why not make things a little more magical?
I am creating portraits for all the villagers that portray them as pointy-eared elves. [center]
All bachelors and bachelorettes complete:[/center]

[b]How to Install:[/b]
Extract the files and copy them into Stardew Valley\Content\Portraits. 
**Please back up before installing!**

[b]Updates:[/b]

1.0 -- Portraits for all six bachelors.
1.0a -- Portraits for all six bachelors with newest version of Sam and Sebastian.
